name: Fly Swatter
blurb: Shoot down a damaged Vertibot to claim salvage.

stages.log_text: An automated survey Vertibot has been spotted in the Ash Heap region. If we can destroy it before it leaves the area, we can claim valuable salvage from the wreckage.
We succeeded is taking down the Vertibot before it was able to leave the area.
We failed to destroy the Vertibot before it was able to escape.
